references.title: C58 FastWAM full30 H3 layerwise carrier champion

architecture.paper: MiniWorld predicts future video conditioned on known actions.
architecture.upstream_code: The only learned target is video velocity; actions enter video-block modulation.
architecture.local: Frozen H3 supplies world K/V and the promoted C58 ActionDiT remains the only action generator.

architecture.paper: Committed chunks use a persistent sink plus bounded FIFO K/V history.
architecture.upstream_code: generate_eval_latents_streaming appends per-block K/V, pins one sink and evicts oldest post-sink chunks.
architecture.local: Only real observation chunks are committed; first observation is pinned and the newest post-sink chunks are retained.

data.paper: Four raw actions condition one Wan-VAE latent transition.
data.upstream_code: build_cond_seq_from_actions prepends a null seed slot and reshapes actions in groups of four.
data.local: Every non-seed real observation requires the exact 4n executed actions that preceded it; no proposed or future action is accepted.

action.local: C58 keeps 7D horizon32 flow action output and replan8 execution unchanged.

objective.upstream_code: forward_diffusion_forcing masks clean context and returns only v_loss.
objective.local: C62 does not port the video objective; C58 action-flow loss trains C58 and the action-to-context modulation route.

optimization.paper: MiniWorld continues 6 to 16 to 32 to 64 latent frames.
optimization.upstream_code: train_droid.sh uses four stages; shape-changing loads are non-strict.
optimization.local: Planned context length curriculum keeps the C58 parent fixed, but every same-shape candidate resume must be strict and bit-exact.

evaluation.paper: MiniWorld evaluates generated videos and throughput.
evaluation.upstream_code: No action-policy or LIBERO success evaluator is provided.
evaluation.local: Mechanism uses held-out action shuffle; effectiveness requires fresh paired LIBERO against C58 under the frozen rollout contract.
